From The Daily Times,
newsroom@shore.intercom.net

COPS BUST LITTLE RED WAGON

Mark Glenn Roberts, 63. of the 43100 block of Main Street Extended, Pittsville, MD, was charged with the manufacture of marijuana, felonious possession of marijuana, possession of marijuana (mandatory), possession of marijuana and possession of drug paraphernalia. The charges were set by order of the court and with the consent of the defendant. The court ordered Roberts to forfeit a John Deere lawn tractor, a Radio Flyer wagon and a yard cart.

(Marijuananews note: Respect for the law?)
